This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fruit and Mushroom mixes are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] and any [[Fruit]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their regular version is made by using either ingredients without status or [[Ingredient]]s with differing effects. Ingredients lacking statuses that can be used are [[Apple]]s, [[Palm Fruit]]s, [[Wildberry|Wildberries]], and [[Hylian Shroom]]s. Eating them will restore some [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]. The sweetness of Fruit in this dish is said to contrast with the savoriness of the Mushrooms. Depending on the Ingredients used, several different versions of Fruit and Mushroom Mix can be made: * '''Hearty Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Durian]]s, [[Hearty Truffle]]s, or [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s. Eating one will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Energizing Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stamella Shroom]]s. When eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Endura Shroom]]s. Consuming these mixes completely refills and overfills Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] or [[Rushroom]]s. If eaten, they will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. * '''Spicy Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Spicy Pepper]]s or [[Sunshroom]]s. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] for a short period of time. * '''Electro Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfruit]]s or [[Zapshroom]]s. They give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Mighty Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Bananas]] or [[Razorshroom]]s. If eaten, they increase the power of Link's attacks for a time. * '''Tough Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Ironshroom]]s. Eating them increases Link's defense temporarily. * '''Sneaky Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Silent Shroom]]s. Eating these mixes will increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period. * '''Chilly Fruit and Mushroom Mix''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fruit and Mushroom Mix}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This dish contrasts the sweetness of fruit with the savoriness of mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hydromelon]]s or [[Chillshroom]]s. When eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] temporarily. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
